description: Section of adobe wall with cracks and fissures, a skull sits on the ground in front of the wall in the lower left, a wooden ladder leans against the center of the wall, desert bush in foreground, another ladder leans against the wall horizontally on the ground, clouds visible above wall.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe's Abiquiu House, Ladder and Skull
